arguments.summary: A credential stuffing attack was detected originating from internal host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), leveraging compromised user credentials (CORP\jsmith) to target the domain controller. The attack originated from a compromised endpoint in the Finance department, indicating a likely initial access via phishing or malware infection.

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_HTTPs_443 {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beaconing over HTTPS on port 443 with common patterns"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        severity = 3
    strings:
        $x64_get_uri = "\/\.\.\/[a-z]{4,6}\/[a-z]{4,6}\/[a-z]{4,6}\/[a-z]{4,6}\/" wide ascii
        $x86_get_uri = "\/\.\.\/[a-z]{4,6}\/[a-z]{4,6}\/" wide ascii
        $post_uri = "\/\.\.\/[a-z]{4,6}\/[a-z]{4,6}\/[a-z]{4,6}\/[a-z]{4,6}\/" wide ascii
        $header = "Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8" wide ascii
    condition:
        any of ($x64_get_uri, $x86_get_uri, $post_uri) and $header
}
